#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
	freopen("task.in", "r", stdin);
	freopen("task.out", "w", stdout);
#endif

	cout.precision(15);
	cout << fixed;

	int n, k;
	while (cin >> n >> k) {
		vector<double> p(n);
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) cin >> p[i];

		vector<double> sum(1 << n, 0.0);
		for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
			for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
				if (i & (1 << j)) {
					sum[i] += p[j];
				}
			}
		}

		int cnt = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			if (p[i] > 1e-5) cnt++;
		}
		if (cnt <= k) {
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
				double pp = (p[i] > 1e-5) ? 1.0 : 0.0;
				if (i == n - 1) cout << pp << '\n';
				else cout << pp << ' ';
			}
			continue;
		}
		vector<double> dp(1 << n, 0.0);
		dp[0] = 1.0;
		for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
			int rmask = (~mask) & ((1 << n) - 1);
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
				if ((rmask & (1 << i)) && p[i] > 1e-5) {
					dp[mask | (1 << i)] += dp[mask] * p[i] / sum[rmask];
				}
			}
		}
		vector<double> ans(n, 0.0);
		for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
			int bitCount = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
				if (mask & (1 << i)) bitCount++;
			}
			if (bitCount != k) continue;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
				if (mask & (1 << i)) {
					ans[i] += dp[mask];
				}
			}
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			if (i == n - 1) cout << ans[i] << '\n';
			else cout << ans[i] << ' ';
		}
	}

	return 0;
}
